question: India defeated West Indies in which of the following World Cup finals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1983 England**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India defeated West Indies** in the final of the **1983 Cricket World Cup** held in England.
 
• This victory was significant as it was India's first-ever World Cup win, marking a historic moment in Indian cricket.
 
• The final match took place on **25th June 1983** at Lord's Cricket Ground in London.
 
• India, led by captain **Kapil Dev**, scored 183 runs, and successfully defended this total by bowling out the West Indies for 140 runs.
 
• This win is often credited with popularizing cricket in India and inspiring a generation of cricketers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **1983 Cricket World Cup** was the third edition of the Cricket World Cup tournament.
 
• It was organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC) and was played from 9th June to 25th June 1983.
 
• The format of the tournament involved a round-robin group stage followed by semi-finals and a final.
 
• India's win in 1983 was a major upset as the West Indies team were the two-time defending champions and favorites to win the tournament.
 
• The victory is often regarded as one of the greatest upsets in the history of cricket.
 
• Kapil Dev's **iconic catch** to dismiss Viv Richards is one of the most memorable moments from the final.
